mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 13 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 13, low 8.

Former Serbian president Aleksandar Vučić personally pressured civil officials to approve the construction of a Trump-branded hotel on the former UN headquarters site in Belgrade, according to Financial Times documents.

The Prishtina Parking company will return to operating in Kosovo's capital with higher fees after the municipal council approved a new regulation governing public parking spaces.

Yonkers, New York, will hold an official ceremony on November 28 to raise the Albanian flag, marking Albania's Flag Day and Independence Day, with the city's mayor inviting the Albanian community.

At the GrowthTank 2026 conference in Pristina, experts discussed how artificial intelligence is reshaping e-commerce, media and marketing agencies in Kosovo's business landscape.

Beekeepers in North Macedonia report a sharp drop in honey production this year, blaming factors beyond their control despite fulfilling their contractual obligations.
